name: flash-keep-awake
description: SSD mode for flash storage (iFlash, CompactFlash and SSD adapters). The iPod keeps the storage on for 30 minutes after each use, not for 1 second. When the iPod wakes from sleep, or when you touch a control after a long pause, the iPod starts the storage at once. Thus the storage is ready when you choose a song. Before the storage power goes off, the iPod waits 0.5 seconds, so that the flash card can complete its writes. iPodFirm finds the type of storage from the size of the connected iPod. If the size does not decide, the iPod examines its drive when it starts. On a hard drive, the patch does nothing.
